fullTextZH: 你好！今天我要说3个可怕的(scary)故事。对 ，
fullTextEN: Hello! Today I want to tell 3 scary stories. Right,
3 scary stories.
The first one I want to tell:

fullTextEN: In China, many, many cats have no ears,

fullTextEN: Right, why do many, many cats have no ears?
Because in China
there is a kind of snack
called cat ears.

fullTextEN: What? You don't want to try cat ears,
You think eating cat ears is not good.
I think you should try,

Maybe you will like it too,
Now take a look

fullTextEN: Do you think it looks tasty or not?
Actually

but I really like this,

Don't worry

fullTextZH: 猫耳朵和猫没有关系(not related) 。
fullTextEN: Cat ears are not related to cats.
The second scary story:
In China, there are many, many flies,
Flies have no heads. Yes,
Many, many flies have no heads

fullTextEN: Why? Because in China there is a dish, yes,
Yes, there is a dish,
This dish is called fried fly heads.
I haven't eaten it,

fullTextZH: 可是我觉得这个菜看起来很好吃，
fullTextEN: but I think this dish looks delicious,
Do you want to try it?
Fried
Fly heads,
Now let's take a look
Stir-fried fly heads,
It's not actually fly heads.
This dish contains garlic shoots,
has meat, has fermented soybeans,

fullTextZH: 你看这个豆豉是黑色的，

so they look like fly heads

fullTextZH: 我觉得这个菜看起来也很好吃，
fullTextEN: I think this dish looks delicious too,
so I want to try it.
The third scary story:
In China, there are many eagles,
many eagles have no beaks
Why?

fullTextZH: 因为很多很多中国人吃
fullTextEN: Because many, many Chinese people eat
chickpeas.
Not really eagle beaks
It's chickpeas,

fullTextZH: 你们觉得鹰嘴斗和鹰嘴像不像(alike) ？
fullTextEN: Do you think chickpeas and eagle beaks look alike?
I think they look a little alike,
This bean and the eagle's beak
are a little bit similar,
so we call it chickpea.
Do you like to eat chickpeas?

fullTextZH: 你知道如果你吃一颗鹰嘴豆，
fullTextEN: Do you know if you eat a chickpea,
there might be an eagle
without a beak.

fullTextEN: Okay, so today I told 3 scary stories,

cat ears,
not real cat ears,
